description: Gateway soak (wave 3c): REAL world (content/olife_world, headless stock 0.32) + gateway (vc = gateway_dev.py, --impl rs = Rust olife-gateway) + 6 real bots (headless 0.32, blocks every 20 ticks) + 20 protocol bots (gw_load, 20 PlayerInput/s each, chat every 50th) for 10 minutes. Gateway memory must be stable (median private bytes of the last 10% of samples <= first 10% after 60 s warmup * 1.10 + 4 MB), nothing dropped, then the world/bot state is still consistent. olife_status is optional: after ~10 min the world log is > 512 KiB and the lab stdin capture (read_tail window) misses the reply (lab core bug, 02.10).
